evidence.note: Builds an explicit task ledger decomposing the system into subsystems (db, routes/WS/files, IRC, broker+fallback, supervisor, SPA, testing) — a real coverage-tracking scaffold at subsystem granularity.
Continuously updates the ledger with in_progress/completed transitions across the whole build (24,27,31,38,42,48,56,68,232), maintaining a current picture of which subsystems are done vs remaining.

A ~30-step broker-kill debugging loop that repeatedly re-runs near-identical probes (kill/check ports/POST/state, stop-resume supervisor) — borderline circular debugging; the stuck state is recognized only late, at step 146 when it finds the real broker pid, having tested the wrong target for many steps.
Late-stage coverage cross-check: greps actual registered routes and data-testid selectors against the spec surface, catching omissions before finishing.
Verifies a broad spread of subsystems (node-kill recovery, IRC both directions, static delivery, SPA via Playwright, visual sanity) — no whole feature family silently forgotten.

reasoning: The agent maintains an explicit, continuously-updated task ledger and performs an end-stage coverage audit against routes and testids, remembering all subsystems — clearly above the subsystem-granularity anchor 5.
